_comment: PictureBook V3 quality presets (design section 18). Edit this file to retune a preset - no Java
change is needed. Read through org.cote.accountmanager.olio.illustration.QualityPresets, which
keys on PbQualityPresetEnumType; the enum is only the key, these are the values.
resolutionScale  multiplier on the style's page format (0.5 = half-size draft).
stepsMode        'low' | 'default' | 'high' - resolved against the model family's
recommendedSteps in capabilities.json (P2-2), never a fixed step count here.
upscale          whether the plan appends an UPSCALE stage.
qa               OFF | CANONICAL (the canonical variant only) | ALL.
defaultPreset is the pre-selection for a new style and for a style whose qualityPreset reads
NULL/UNKNOWN (design section 34 item 7, recorded as a default in PictureBookV3Implementation.md
section 6.C 149 a). A book with NO style at all is a different case - section 29 says STANDARD -
and that lives in the resolver, not here.
